notes: ACCESS: plain curl (Chrome UA impersonation) worked throughout, HTTP 200 on every page, no WAF/challenge encountered - HTTP-first tier sufficient. ROBOTS: https://www.eq3.com/robots.txt fetched first (HTTP 200). No ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/anthropic-ai/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot group exists at all. The only groups are Pinterest(bot) crawl-delay entries and a generic 'User-agent: *' that disallows /ca/en/account/*, /ca/fr/account/*, /us/en/account/*, /ca|fr/en/cart(/*), /ca|fr|us/*/checkout/*, and /_next/static|image - none of which cover the category/product-listing paths used here, so proceeding was clear. TREE: the site's homepage (https://www.eq3.com/ca/en) embeds a Next.js dehydrated-state JSON containing the ENTIRE site category/subcategory/product-line tree (categories 0-9: Living, Dining, Bedroom, Office, Accessories, Brands/eq3plus, Inspiration, Gifts, Sale, plus every subcategory and product-line under each). This tree was regex-scanned case-insensitively for bath|vanity|toilet|shower|faucet|sink|tap|basin|bidet across every 'name'/'slug' field in the whole document; the ONLY hit anywhere on the site is a single product line: 'Bathroom Accessories' (id clavje92c0xif0118lgfp1346, slug bathroom-accessories) under Accessories(7) > Accents(72). EQ3 is a furniture/home-accessories retailer with no fixtures, vanities, sinks, toilets, showers, taps or bathroom furniture lines - confirmed absent, not just unsearched. RESULT: fetched https://www.eq3.com/ca/en/category/accessories/accents/bathroom-accessories (HTTP 200). Its embedded product-instance/search API payload (queryKey filtered to categoryId=7, subcategoryId=72, productLineId=clavje92c0xif0118lgfp1346) returns count:10, and exactly 10 product-instance objects (verified by counting 'coloursAvailable' occurrences = 10) are present, all carrying slugs.productline=bathroom-accessories - qty=10 double-verified. QTY composition inspected: Trickle Shower Curtain (1) is a shower curtain -> excluded per rule 20 (Textile-owned; no separate URL exists to route it to, single mixed listing page); Solid Teak Stool - Cylinder/Rectangle/Round (3) are general accent stools/side-tables per their own description ('versatile enough to be used as stools, nightstands, or end tables') -> primary product type is furniture, excluded per rules 2/30-33 despite site placement, no separate URL to route. Remaining 6 (Spy Rectangle Mirror, Puddle Mirror Small/Medium/Large, Stak Containers, Orb Wood Knob) are genuine bathroom accessories/mirrors/storage/hardware per rules 9/10/12/17 and are kept in the recorded qty since the page has one shared URL/count and rule 26 requires the exact figure shown on the listing page (10), not a manually re-tallied subset; the composition caveat is flagged on the row for downstream review. DEDUP: checked cross_category_url_index.json - https://www.eq3.com/ca/en/category/accessories/accents/bathroom-accessories -> None (new, safe to record). The site's separate general 'Mirrors' product line (https://www.eq3.com/ca/en/category/accessories/accents/mirrors, 13 items: Hex Mirror, Spy Floor Mirror, Alto Mirror, Canto Oval/Square Mirror, Core Dresser Mirror, plus 4 of the same bathroom-listed mirrors cross-listed) is NOT a bathroom-named/bathroom-specific node - it is EQ3's general home-decor mirror line and is already recorded in Wall_Decor.xlsx per the cross-category index (confirmed hit: ['Wall_Decor.xlsx']), so it is correctly excluded here and not duplicated. No other Bathroom subcategories exist to record. Confidence on Orb Wood Knob and Stak Containers is medium (site hierarchy is the deciding evidence per rule 9; no product detail description was retrievable to confirm exact function) - kept in scope, not flagged to review, per rule 9's hierarchy-decides default.
